# Juan Carlos Estévez Rodríguez · jc-root.xyz

Senior iOS Engineer, available for hire (freelance, full-time or remote).
Dual Mexican–Spanish citizen. Working languages: English (C2), Spanish
(native), French (B2).

## Summary

6+ years of professional iOS experience plus 2 earlier years shipping
production code. Takes full ownership of features and architecture, from
the first call through release. Specialties: Swift, SwiftUI (incl. 6),
UIKit, Objective-C, Combine, Swift Concurrency (async/await, Swift 6
strict concurrency), Vapor 4 (server-side Swift, since Vapor 3), MVVM,
Clean Architecture, Coordinators, XCTest + XCUITest (Robot Pattern), Swift
Package Manager, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Accessibility (a11y, VoiceOver),
Internationalization (i18n).
Media and creative tools: Final Cut Pro, GarageBand, ffmpeg (scripted video automation).
Modernizes legacy codebases, builds for
accessibility, treats testing as part of the craft. At Alaska Airlines,
made an assistive hardware keypad drive VoiceOver on airport bag tag
stations. On the App Store since
2018 with multilingual apps for iOS, iPadOS and macOS. Recently
expanded into AI agentic workflows (Claude, OpenAI, xAI, Ollama) and
hardware-software integration. Owns two products end to end: Sideshore
(wind forecast, native SwiftUI on iOS, iPadOS and macOS) and Zhen
(open-source macOS network scanner in Swift 6).

## Selected work

- Sideshore: wind forecast and live-station app in native SwiftUI for iOS,
  iPadOS and macOS 26, MapKit, on-device data layer over Open-Meteo and NOAA:
  https://apps.apple.com/app/sideshore/id6820650870
  https://jctec.github.io/sideshore-site/
- Zhen: fast, native macOS network scanner, open source in Swift 6, with an engine
  and CLI (zhen-core), SwiftUI app for macOS 26 (zhen-app) and a
  pre-registered measurement study (zhen-study); async/await and actors
  throughout, under Swift 6 strict checking:
  https://github.com/zhen-swift
- jc-root.xyz: this site, open source; a static build in plain Node with no
  npm dependencies that generates the page, structured data and CV in three
  languages; accessible by design (AAA contrast, reading settings with
  OpenDyslexic or Atkinson Hyperlegible, text size, high contrast, WCAG text
  spacing):
  https://github.com/JCTec/jc-root.xyz
- After Dark Stories: AI-assisted fiction studio built and operated solo on
  server-side Swift (Vapor, Fluent, PostgreSQL, Leaf), with accounts, token
  auth, billing and moderation in three locales:
  https://afterdarkstories.mx
- MythLog: consent-first macOS system event ledger (HMAC hash chain):
  https://apps.apple.com/app/mythlog/id6797111874
- Tapper Counters: SwiftUI tap-to-count app (iOS, iPadOS):
  https://apps.apple.com/app/tapper-counters/id6475695007
- iCalendarKit: open-source Swift iCalendar (RFC 5545) encoder:
  https://github.com/swift-calendar/icalendarkit
- iBase: number-base converter, on the App Store since 2018:
  https://apps.apple.com/app/ibase/id1346871946
